name: smwgraphics-parodius-non-sense-fantasy-labyrinth-boss-room
title: Parodius: Non-Sense Fantasy - Labyrinth (Boss Room)
description:
The background of the boss room from Labyrinth, the third stage of Parodius Da / Parodius: Non-Sense Fantasy. It's found in the area where the player fight Hot Lips. Depending of the outcome of the battle, the faces in the background will change.

Includes three variants:
- Normal (seen while fighting the boss.)
- Boss Defeated;
- Failure (The player didn't kill the boss fast enough);

Each of these variants is organized in their own folders, so pick the one you like the most.

A good fit for bonus / castles, in general.
